record.title: Mexico’s Chamber of Deputies docket lists a federal AI governance and technology-transfer bill pending in committee
record.summary: Mexico’s official SIL docket index lists a Chamber of Deputies initiative presented by José Alejandro Aguilar López (PT) on 15 September 2026 and pending in the originating committee as of that date. Its official summary describes a proposed federal risk-based governance framework for AI development, commercialization and use, and a technology-linkage program to transfer university knowledge to micro, small and medium enterprises. This is a proposal, not enacted law. The full bill text and a later committee status were not directly inspectable in this activation.
organizations: Secretariat of Governance Legislative Information System

claims.text: The SIL summary describes the initiative as proposing federal risk-based governance for AI development, commercialization and use, plus an AI technology-linkage program transferring university knowledge to micro, small and medium enterprises. The bill text was not directly inspected.

evidence_gaps.description: The full bill text and directly inspectable legislative tracking page were not available in this activation; the official indexed summary does not establish exact provisions, later committee action or legal status beyond the 2026-09-15 pending entry.

brief.importance_rationale: If enacted, a federal risk-based AI governance framework and university-to-SME technology-transfer program could shape public-sector AI rules and diffusion in Mexico. The official SIL index currently supports a bounded proposal/status account; bill text was not directly inspectable and no enactment or implementation is claimed.
limitations: The record is a bill proposal, not enacted law or operative AI duty.
